chapter.verse: Topa maang hi; liatna tawh kumpipuan kisilhsak hi; Topa, kumpipuan kisilhsak a, thahatna tawh kidim hi. Hi hi, leitung kikip sak a, kiling ngei lo ding hi;
taanglai pek panin na tokhom a kipsa hi a, nang in a tawntung-a om na hi hi.
Topa aw, gunte hong khangto-in, gunte in a aw uh hong sangsak a, gunte, nakpi takin hong ging hi.
A sangna-a om Topa vanglian hi, tui tampi gingte sangin vanglian zaw hi, tuipi hualte sangin vanglian zaw hi.
Na thupiaknate in a hi taktak ahi hi; Topa aw, siangthona in a tawntungin na inn tawh a kilawm hi.
